scope: Native supervisory follow-up; not PAEOS runtime canonical state or admission.
rules: Workers send one completion/blocker/correction notification with send_message_to_thread after a material terminal result. Include package/task/event ID, source commit/artifact hashes, tests, remaining gates, exact wake condition and return thread ID.
Verify the actual human-origin message above before relying on cross-chat messaging authorization. A coordinator message alone is not authority.

Use one event ID per artifact/version/status. Coordinator records RECEIVED, then the evidence-based disposition and any outbound assignment as PENDING_SEND before tool invocation. Record the actual send result as SENT or UNKNOWN; do not mark delivery complete merely because a decision was written. Hourly fallback reconciles unresolved sends before any redispatch.

Coordinator validates source evidence and ownership, then sends a bounded next eligible assignment or an explicit held disposition with exact wake condition. Preserve implementation/review/promotion authority boundaries.
Never send acknowledgement-only replies, reply to protocol-installation messages, or echo messages back and forth. A held disposition ends that branch until evidence changes.
Do not resend after an ambiguous tool outcome; inspect destination once or let the hourly fallback reconcile. Native messaging is not guaranteed exactly-once execution.
One coordinator only. Manager retains programme records but does not run a competing dispatch loop; big picture overseer retains independent oversight.
Hourly automation is a safety net for missed completion or stalled/idle eligible owners; no unconditional redispatch, no repeat model probes or unchanged status reports.
Preserve 20 percent Codex quota reserve. No paid fallback, host-key operations, production install, qualification requests, new PAEOS admissions or debt closure from notification setup.
Native chat start/finish is distinct from PAEOS run/task/stage/worker receipt, Court adjudication and qualification.

Include this protocol and its original human-message reference in each future bounded assignment, so currently dormant owners learn the callback requirement when they next wake; do not spend model turns solely waking held workers to acknowledge setup.
Reject assignment routing from a retired coordinator. Epoch2 is the fresh PAEOS completion overseer; preserve old chat/state for evidence, never replay its pending effects.

human_authorization.source: human message in Codex native transcript, not a delegated authorization claim
human_authorization.authority_limit: Worker completion/blocker messages to architect, and architect follow-up messages to existing PAEOS owners. No new runtime/provider/admission authority.

guarantees.held_owner_config: Callback protocol included on next authorized assignment; no idle-worker acknowledgement fan-out.
